title: Low-rank blocked-row universal grading audit
top_notice: A fusion-rule-only universal grading audit was completed for the six procurement-blocked low-rank rows. The audit formally finds nontrivial universal character sectors for rank3-ising and rank5-su2-4, formally finds trivial universal grading for the three PSU(2) adjoint rows, and leaves rank5-psu3-4 blocked because no repo-local machine-readable fusion table is pinned. This note does not establish ribbon realization data and does not authorize scan-plan generation.
